name: Smart Automations
source: Smart Automations Panel V1.0.0 exact + layout V1.0.0 + color guard V1.0.0 + responsive V1.0.0 + alert control V1.1.0
frontend_source: Smart Automations Panel V1.0.0 + smart-automations-layout.js + smart-automations-runtime.js + smart-automations-responsive.js + smart-automations-alert-control.js
alert_control_features: 1/2 notifications, optional time window, configurable discard/pending out-of-hours behavior, pending cancellation by rearm, second-notification recheck, optional controlled rearm/hysteresis, silent duplicate-run handling while mode: single is waiting
migration: none; existing smart_automations.config version 1 remains valid; existing native automations are not rewritten automatically
native_automation_contract: Home Assistant remains the execution engine; high_power and energy_limit are extended only when saved from Smart Automations; mode single keeps max_exceeded silent; pending mode waits natively for schedule start or rearm
notes: No helpers are created. Existing configs default to discard for compatibility. Existing native automations must be opened and saved to opt into Alert Control V1.1.0.
